about: Scripted answers for the fictional Robin Sample (cv_robin_sample.pdf) applying to job_ad_demo.txt. Yes to what the CV supports (Java and PostgreSQL backend, Python scripts, Docker, GitHub Actions, an LLM hackathon prototype) and to travel and the Hamburg office; no to FastAPI, Django, RAG, cloud, Kubernetes and LLM evaluation, which the CV doesn't show. 'No' rules are checked first, so 'LLMs and RAG' is a no.
